criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Nine frames differ in world, camera, scale and medium, each built for its sentence; 3 strongest, 8 and 2 strong with counts asserted in code, 1 survives the zoom. Held down by 6 (faceless mannequin from behind, laptop lost in shadow, empty caliche left 40 percent), 4 (roof reads as floating with no wall under the eave, straight cylinder limb, dark seat over the top 40 percent), 5 (no hand so the plate hangs, dek on a dark seat blob), 9 (route stops dead mid street, dek covers the haze band).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds; gold is the route on 1, 4, 7, 9 only; the motif changes state; the 1 and 9 mirror works. Frame 5 is the one frame off the outdoor ground; frame 2's centre line is close to the accent.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and drawn counts are asserted in code; scopes honest; absence scoped. Off 10: 'Florida made it procedure' and the caption opener turn one state team into 'Florida' and the opener drops the attribution; c20's text adds 'runs in the field' beyond its quote and c17's text adds the dataset join; frame 1 draws a two-colour rim ramp under a dek that disclaims only the neighbourhood.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader learns what CLARKE does and who built it; no Texas place on any surface, no Texas body decided, 'Watch for the first' is passive; the caption question is the one Texas stake.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 3 to 7 walk the process, 9 turns home; 5 breaks the process run and could move after 7.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: House rules clean; plain specific headlines; some source jargon untranslated.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New techniques and tone rotation, but the third drone deck in five days and the second Texas A&M disaster-response deck in four.

one_sentence_fix: Scope the close and caption opener to the source (Texas A&M says Florida's state drone team made it procedure) and name the Texas place the docket files it under.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Faceless mannequin from behind, laptop lost in shadow, empty caliche left 40 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Three-quarter front camera at tailgate height so the screen-lit face and hands fill the middle half; bed and case into the foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Roof reads as hovering with no wall under the eave, straight cylinder limb, dark plate behind the type.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Walls and contact under the eave visible, a barked limb with crown, a lower oblique so lawn and street give the type quiet.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: With the hand removed the plate floats above its slot; strata read as a comb; dek on a dark blob.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Seat the pulled plate in its slot raised a hand's height against the end plate with contact; rake the key along the edges; type on the plain wall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Route stops abruptly mid street with a rounded cap; dek covers the upper half.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Curve the route onto a near driveway or off the bottom edge so it arrives somewhere; lower the camera so near roofs fill the bottom third.
